manual.title: Pennsylvania Pesticide Applicator Certification Core Manual
manual.publisher: Penn State Extension, Pesticide Education Program

p: This card is practice. It is **not** from your manual, and it does not count toward your progress.
Press **Play** to hear it read in a Claude voice.
The **yellow highlight** follows the voice, word by word.
Tap any sentence to start reading from that spot.
After each card, you get a quiz, one question at a time.
The manual's own review questions come first.
Then come new questions written like the real test, including scenario questions and **NOT** questions.
You pass a card only at **100 percent**.
Every question you miss comes back later in the session.
It comes back again next session.
It stays on your weak list until you get it right **twice in a row**.

list: Each session starts with a **5-question rapid round** from old cards.
Then you study the next card and take its quiz.
Each session ends with what you mastered, what you are weak on, and what is next.

explain: The loop is simple: rapid round, study card, quiz.
A perfect quiz passes the card. Any miss means you retake it.

terms.def: Questions you missed that you have not yet answered right twice in a row.
Five quick questions from old cards at the start of every session.

questions.q: What score do you need to pass a card?
questions.why: Anything under 100 percent is a fail.

questions.q: A missed question leaves your weak list after you answer it right once.
questions.why: You have to get it right twice in a row.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT part of a study session?
choices: A 5-question rapid round from old cards
A summary of what you mastered and what is weak
questions.why: Sessions are rapid round, cards, quizzes, and a summary. There is no timed mock exam.

questions.q: Type it: how many times in a row must you get a missed question right to clear it?
questions.why: Twice in a row clears it.
